text: {"assertions":["A floating point rounding issue in the money calculation path caused broken layout in the email renderer.","The layout issue manifested as table overflow in the plain text part of emails generated by the renderer.","The problem occurred only when processing deeply nested inputs beyond six levels deep.","The fix converted arithmetic calculations from floating point to integer minor units in PR #1360 on branch fix/broken-layout-1.","The issue can be reproduced by rendering the digest template with a long subject line.","The fix improved p99 latency from 1.8 seconds to 678 milliseconds.","The fix is covered by tests in tests/notifications/test_render.py."]}
